Companion Animal Travel Desk
This article covers rabbit travel records and the checks that support them. Use it as a quick guide before you arrive at the airport.

Bring the health paperwork the desk asks for and keep it ready for review at check-in. <<FACT F082>> The staff will compare the form with the travel file and note any mismatch in the ledger before the animal moves forward.

The carrier must be secure, clean, and fitted for safe handling. <<FACT F064>> If the crate or the pet appears outside the listed limit, the desk will pause the filing and send the case for a calm review. That review helps the team confirm whether the booking can continue as entered or needs a change.

The cabin team monitors animals during flight and gives steady attention throughout the trip. Staff log service changes, feeding notes, and any extra handling in the desk record so the route stays clear for everyone involved. If a traveler brings a companion animal with a special care need, the desk will follow the normal stepwise review and keep the response plain and orderly.

For a smooth handoff, arrive with the carrier closed, the documents grouped together, and the animal settled before the queue. If the plan changes, speak with the desk early so the record can be updated without delay.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
